operations.name: forum.boards
operations.purpose: MyAnimeListForumApi.boards gets the MyAnimeList forum board tree through `MalForumOperation.boards`. It is the public facade for `GET /forum/boards`; use MalRequestOptions transport settings to override per call.

request.name: options
request.description: Optional transport settings; a MalRequestOptions merged over the instance defaults.

nestedFields.name: timeout
nestedFields.description: Milliseconds before a request is aborted. `0` disables the Axios timeout. Defaults to DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT; timeout errors carry the effective duration as `AniLinkNetworkError.timeoutMs`.

nestedFields.name: signal
nestedFields.description: Signal used to cancel in-flight requests.

response.name: categories
response.description: The forum categories, each carrying its boards.

errors.condition: for timeout, cancellation, or other transport failures

operations.name: forum.topics
operations.purpose: MyAnimeListForumApi.topics gets the MyAnimeList forum topic list through `MalForumOperation.topics`. It is the public facade for `GET /forum/topics`; filter by board, keyword, or creator with MalForumTopicsParams and page with `limit`/`offset`.

request.name: params
request.description: The topic-list read inputs; a MalForumTopicsParams carrying the optional board, keyword, creator, sort, and paging filters.

nestedFields.name: boardId
nestedFields.description: The board to list topics of, when limiting to one board.

nestedFields.name: subboardId
nestedFields.description: The subboard to list topics of, when limiting to one subboard.

nestedFields.name: q
nestedFields.description: The keyword to filter topic titles by.

nestedFields.name: topicUserName
nestedFields.description: The user name whose created topics to list.

nestedFields.name: userName
nestedFields.description: The user name whose posts to list topics by.

nestedFields.name: sort
nestedFields.description: The sort order; one of MalForumTopicSort.

nestedFields.name: limit
nestedFields.description: The number of entries per page; defaults to 100, capped at 100 by MyAnimeList.

nestedFields.name: offset
nestedFields.description: The offset of the first entry; defaults to 0.

request.name: options
request.description: Optional transport settings; a MalRequestOptions merged over the instance defaults.

nestedFields.name: timeout
nestedFields.description: Milliseconds before a request is aborted. `0` disables the Axios timeout. Defaults to DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT; timeout errors carry the effective duration as `AniLinkNetworkError.timeoutMs`.

nestedFields.name: signal
nestedFields.description: Signal used to cancel in-flight requests.

response.name: data
response.description: The topic entries on this page.

response.name: paging
response.description: The paging node with the next/previous page URLs, when the list continues.

nestedFields.name: next
nestedFields.description: The URL of the next page, when the list continues.

nestedFields.name: previous
nestedFields.description: The URL of the previous page, when the list continues backwards.

errors.condition: for timeout, cancellation, or other transport failures

operations.name: forum.topic
operations.purpose: MyAnimeListForumApi.topic gets one forum topic with its posts and poll through `MalForumOperation.topic`. It is the public facade for `GET /forum/topic/{topic_id}`; page through a long topic's posts with the `limit`/`offset` fields of MalForumTopicParams.

request.name: params
request.description: The topic read inputs; a MalForumTopicParams carrying the topic ID plus the optional post-paging filters.

nestedFields.name: id
nestedFields.description: The MyAnimeList forum topic ID.

nestedFields.name: limit
nestedFields.description: The number of posts per page; defaults to 100, capped at 100 by MyAnimeList.

nestedFields.name: offset
nestedFields.description: The offset of the first post; defaults to 0.

request.name: options
request.description: Optional transport settings; a MalRequestOptions merged over the instance defaults.

nestedFields.name: timeout
nestedFields.description: Milliseconds before a request is aborted. `0` disables the Axios timeout. Defaults to DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT; timeout errors carry the effective duration as `AniLinkNetworkError.timeoutMs`.

nestedFields.name: signal
nestedFields.description: Signal used to cancel in-flight requests.

response.name: data
response.description: The topic's detail: title, posts, and poll.

nestedFields.name: title
nestedFields.description: The topic's title.

nestedFields.name: posts
nestedFields.description: The topic's posts on this page.

nestedFields.name: poll
nestedFields.description: The topic's poll, when one is attached.

response.name: paging
response.description: The paging node with the next/previous post-page URLs, when the topic continues.

nestedFields.name: next
nestedFields.description: The URL of the next page, when the list continues.

nestedFields.name: previous
nestedFields.description: The URL of the previous page, when the list continues backwards.

errors.condition: for timeout, cancellation, or other transport failures
